put.description: Platform authority required. Recompute impact token under ordered resource/share then organization/exclusive locks. Stale revision or impact returns 412 without effects. Disable atomically revokes all scoped active grants, increments each changed membership version once and revokes whole pending invitations containing this pair. Reenable grants nothing. Exceeding the impact cap returns 409 before writes.
